# redfish_ami_fan_assignment (Resource)

One fan assignment slot of an AMI MegaRAC BMC: temperature sensor -> open-loop table -> fans. Fans only follow the table while their mode is customized (redfish_ami_fan_mode).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# TEMP_CPU drives table 1 for FAN1 and FAN7. The fans follow it only in mode "customized".
resource "redfish_ami_fan_assignment" "cpu" {
  redfish_server { redfish_alias = "bmc" }
  slot        = 1
  temp_sensor = "TEMP_CPU"
  table       = 1
  fans        = [1, 7]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fans` (Set of Number) Fan header numbers that follow the table.
- `slot` (Number) Assignment slot number.
- `table` (Number) Open-loop table number.
- `temp_sensor` (String) Temperature sensor name, e.g. TEMP_CPU.

### Optional

- `redfish_server` (Block List) List of server BMCs and their respective user credentials (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--redfish_server))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--redfish_server"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redfish_server`

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Server BMC IP address or hostname
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password for login
- `redfish_alias` (String) Alias name for server BMCs. The key in provider's `redfish_servers` map
- `ssl_insecure` (Boolean) This field indicates whether the SSL/TLS certificate must be verified or not
- `user` (String) User name for login
